Settings.Notifications.Title: Reminders
Settings.Notifications.Lead: Clients get a text before their visit. A reminder that would fall in quiet hours waits until they are over, so nobody is woken up.
Settings.Notifications.QuietHint: No texts are sent between these times. Set both to the same time to switch quiet hours off.
Settings.Notifications.Validation.Second: The second reminder must be closer to the visit than the first.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Title: Deposits and cancellations
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Lead: Set the deposit a booking asks for, how late a client may change or cancel a visit for free, and what a late cancellation or a missed visit costs. Clients see these rules before they book.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.FreeChangeHo: Free to change or cancel until (hours before the visit)
0 means until the visit starts. Later than this, clients can no longer change the time online and a cancellation counts as late.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.LateFee: Late cancellation fee (% of the price)
Settings.CancellationPolicy.NoShowFeeHin: For a client who does not turn up. 0 means no fee.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Note: Nothing is charged automatically. When a visit is missed or cancelled late, you see the fee and decide whether to add it to the client's account.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Saved: The cancellation policy has been saved.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.P: The percentage must be between 0 and 100.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.Validation.L: A late cancellation fee needs a notice period: set the hours above 0.
Settings.CancellationPolicy.DepositHint: Asked for when a visit is booked. 0 means no deposit. A service or a client can have their own rule.
Settings.Notifications.EmailHint: Confirmations, reminders and messages about a cancelled or moved visit also go to the email address on the client card. Texts are sent either way.
Settings.SalonDetails.Title: Salon details
Settings.SalonDetails.Lead: Where clients find you and how they reach you. They see this when they book and at the end of their emails.
Settings.SalonDetails.Name: Name of the place (optional)
Settings.SalonDetails.NameHint: Only if it differs from the name of the salon.
Settings.SalonDetails.Saved: The salon details have been saved.
Settings.SalonDetails.Validation.Phone: Enter a phone number: digits, with spaces if you like, for example 020 7946 0020.
Settings.Notifications.ConfirmDeskBookin: Confirm bookings made at the desk
A client you book in by phone or in person gets the same confirmation as one who books online, with their own link to change or cancel.
Settings.Messages.Title: Messages to clients
Settings.Messages.Lead: The texts and emails your clients receive. Change the wording to sound like your salon, or keep the standard text.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Confirmat: Sent right after a visit is booked.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Reminder: Sent before the visit, at the times set under Reminders.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Cancelled: Sent when a visit is cancelled, by the client or by the salon.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Reschedul: Sent when a visit gets a new time.
Settings.Messages.When.Booking.Code: Sent when a client books online, to check the phone number.
Settings.Messages.Subject: Subject
Settings.Messages.PlaceholdersHint: Type a name exactly as shown, with the double curly brackets. It is replaced when the message is sent.
Settings.Messages.Token.ClientFirstName: the first name of the client
Settings.Messages.Token.AppointmentStart: day and time of the visit
Settings.Messages.Token.CancelUrl: the link the client uses to change or cancel the visit
Settings.Messages.Token.BookingUrl: the link to your booking page
Settings.Messages.Token.Code: the code the client types in
Settings.Messages.ResetDone: The standard wording is in use again.
Settings.Messages.PreviewUnsaved: This is a preview of what you typed. It is not saved yet.
Settings.Messages.LengthUnicode: An emoji or a curly apostrophe (’) makes each text hold 70 characters instead of 160.
Settings.Messages.Validation.NotAllowed: This message cannot use {0}. It can use: {1}.
Settings.Messages.Validation.Required: Keep {0} in the message. Without it the message is of no use to the client.
Settings.NextVisit.Title: Next visit
Settings.NextVisit.Lead: When a client pays, the desk is offered up to three one-tap choices for booking the next visit. Set how many weeks ahead each one is.
Settings.NextVisit.Hint: 0 leaves a choice out. The longest is {0} weeks. The same number twice is offered once.
Settings.NextVisit.OfferedTitle: What the desk sees after a payment
Settings.NextVisit.NothingOffered: No next visit is offered after a payment. Set at least one choice above 0 to offer one.
Settings.NextVisit.Saved: The choices for the next visit have been saved.
Settings.DailySummary.Title: Daily summary by email
Settings.DailySummary.Lead: The numbers of the day in one email to the owners of the salon: what was taken, the visits, and what is booked for tomorrow. No client is named.
Settings.DailySummary.SendAtHint: On the clock of the salon. It goes out within five minutes of this time, once a day.
Settings.DailySummary.Recipients.One: It goes to the {0} owner login of this salon.
Settings.DailySummary.Recipients.Many: It goes to the {0} owner logins of this salon.
Settings.DailySummary.NoRecipients: This salon has no active owner login, so there is nobody to write to.
Settings.DailySummary.PreviewTitle: What the summary of today would say now
Settings.DailySummary.Saved: The daily summary settings have been saved.
Settings.DailySummary.Email.Subject: {0}: {1} taken on {2}
Settings.DailySummary.Email.Tomorrow: Booked for tomorrow: {0}, the first at {1}
Settings.DailySummary.Email.Footer: You get this email because the daily summary is switched on in Settings.
Settings.YourData.Title: Your data
Settings.YourData.Lead: Everything this salon has put in belongs to the salon. Download it whenever you like, as often as you like, at no charge. Nothing is held back if you leave.
Settings.YourData.Clients.Title: Clients
Settings.YourData.Clients.What: Names, phone numbers, email addresses, notes, marketing consent, how many visits each client had, and their last and next visit.
Settings.YourData.Years.Title: Visits and money, year by year
Settings.YourData.Years.What: One row per visit, whatever became of it, and one row per payment, deposit or refund.
Settings.YourData.Products.Title: Products and stock
Settings.YourData.Products.What: Every product with its price, what it costs you and what is on the shelf today.
Settings.YourData.Notes.Title: Good to know
Settings.YourData.Notes.Format: The files are CSV. Excel, Numbers and Google Sheets open them, and so does any other salon system.
Settings.YourData.Notes.Health: Health notes are not in any file. They stay encrypted on the card of the client.
Settings.YourData.Notes.Care: A downloaded file holds personal data and is yours to keep safe. Each download of the client list is recorded with who took it.
Settings.Waitlist.Title: Waitlist on the booking pages
Settings.Waitlist.Lead: Let somebody who finds no time that suits leave their name and number. They appear on the waitlist of the desk, and you fill a freed time from your own clients.
Settings.Waitlist.Enabled: Offer "tell me when a time comes up" on the booking pages
Settings.Waitlist.Hint: The offer is shown under the times of every service.
Settings.Waitlist.Notes.Title: Good to know
Settings.Waitlist.Notes.Checked: The number is checked with a text message code before anybody reaches your list, the same way as a booking.
Settings.Waitlist.Notes.Desk: Nobody is messaged automatically. The desk works the list from the top and gets in touch.
Settings.Waitlist.Notes.NoMarketplace: These are your clients. Nobody else sees the list or offers them another salon.
Settings.Waitlist.TellWhenFreed: Text the first person waiting when a visit is cancelled
Settings.Waitlist.TellWhenFreedHint: One text, to whoever asked first for that service, day and person, with a link to book the time. Not at night, and not more than once a day to the same person. Each text costs what your texts cost.
Settings.Waitlist.Notes.Texts: The text holds nothing for anybody: whoever books first has the time, and the desk still has the whole list.
Settings.Messages.When.Waitlist.TimeFree: Sent to the first client waiting when a visit is cancelled, if you have switched that on under Waitlist.
Settings.Waitlist.Saved: The waitlist settings have been saved.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Title: Payment methods
Settings.PaymentMethods.Lead: The ways your salon takes money. Add your own, such as PayPal or a second card machine, and switch off the ones you do not use.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Own.Title: Your own methods
Settings.PaymentMethods.Own.None: You have not added any yet.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Name: Name
Settings.PaymentMethods.RetireHint.Used: Money was recorded with it, so it stays in the till and the reports. It only leaves the lists.
Settings.PaymentMethods.RetireHint.Unuse: Nothing was recorded with it yet, so it is removed.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Add.Label: Add a method
Settings.PaymentMethods.Add.Hint: The name the desk will pick from the list, for example PayPal.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Retired.Title: No longer used
Settings.PaymentMethods.BuiltIn.Title: Standard methods
Settings.PaymentMethods.BuiltIn.Hint: Untick the ones your salon does not take. They leave the lists; what was already recorded stays.
Settings.PaymentMethods.BuiltIn.CashAlwa: Always on: the cash-up counts the drawer.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Added: {0} is added. The desk can choose it now.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Refused.NameInva: Give the method a name of at most {0} characters.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Refused.NameTake: There is already a method with that name.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Refused.TooMany: A salon can have {0} methods of its own. Stop using one to add another.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Notes.Title: Good to know
Settings.PaymentMethods.Notes.RecordOnly: A method here only records how you were paid. Nothing is charged through it and no account details are asked for.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Notes.Everywhere: Your methods appear wherever money is taken or given back, and as their own lines in the till, the reports and the daily summary.
Settings.PaymentMethods.Notes.History: Renaming a method does not change what was already recorded.
Settings.Privacy.Title: Privacy notice
Settings.Privacy.Lead: What your clients are told about their details. They can read it from every page they see and from the booking form.
Settings.Privacy.NotAdvice: The standard notice says what this system does with client details. It is a starting text, not legal advice. Read it, and use your own text if something is different in your salon.
Settings.Privacy.See: Read the notice as your clients see it
Settings.Privacy.UseOwnText: Show my own text in place of the standard notice
Settings.Privacy.UseOwnTextHint: Your salon's name, address and how to reach you are still shown above and below it.
Settings.Privacy.OwnTextHint: Plain text. Leave an empty line between paragraphs. It is kept here while the standard notice is shown.
Settings.Privacy.Validation.TextRequired: Write your own text, or untick the box to show the standard notice.
Settings.Privacy.Notes.Title: Good to know
Settings.Privacy.Notes.Where: Clients find the notice at the bottom of every page they see, next to the booking form and next to the waitlist form.
Settings.Privacy.Notes.Details: The salon's name, address, phone number and email come from "Salon details". Keep them up to date.
Settings.Privacy.Notes.Rights: When a client asks for a copy of their data or to be deleted, open their card: both are at the bottom.
